$comment: Curated. Maps every extracted component to one canonical component. `canonical` names come from the accepted vocabulary.md. test/component-map.test.mjs fails when an extracted component is unmapped.

components.note: Native select in all three stacks. Searchable and remote modes belong to Combobox.

components.rename: Modal → Dialog across all stacks, matching the pilot issue and the native element.

components.note: Livewire has no DropdownItem; items are Menu components placed inside the dropdown.
Different mounting models: Livewire renders one component and is driven by a window event plus the Toast trait; React and Vue use a provider and a hook/composable.

components.consolidation: Choices + ChoicesOffline → Combobox with local filtering and a `remote` mode (D-020).
components.note: New to React and Vue.

components.consolidation: Consolidated into Combobox `multiple` + `allowCreate` (D-020); Livewire `tags` is a deprecated alias.
Consolidated into Select with `{ label, options }` option groups (D-025); Livewire `select-group` is a deprecated alias.
Consolidated into DatePicker `time` mode (D-021); Livewire `datetime` is a deprecated alias.

components.rename: Radio → RadioGroup, since every stack's Radio is an options-driven group.
components.consolidation: `radio` and `radio-group` overlap almost entirely (only `inline` vs `horizontal` differ). `group` is the same options API rendered as a joined button group, which becomes a `variant`.

components.note: `File` in every stack; Vue keeps `FileUpload` as a deprecated alias (vocabulary decision 5, D-025).

components.rename: errors → validation-summary, so it is not confused with ErrorState.
components.note: Reads Laravel's error bag. Not the same thing as React/Vue ErrorDisplay.
React and Vue ports start from the signature pads already in forms.
Same purpose, different engines: Livewire embeds TinyMCE with uploads; React and Vue use a bare contentEditable. These are not at feature parity even though all stacks 'have' it.
components.launchException: All three stacks, different engines. TinyMCE stays Livewire-only; React and Vue keep their lighter editor.

components.rename: Editor → CodeEditor. The same word means TinyMCE in Livewire and a monospace textarea here.
components.note: Ships in all three stacks as a component (#53, D-028); new to Livewire.

components.structure: Livewire is compositional (five components); React and Vue are data-driven (`items`).
components.consolidation: Menu* are one family, with composition as the base; see vocabulary.md, 'Data-driven vs compositional'.

components.structure: Livewire is compositional (`tab` children); React and Vue are data-driven (`tabs`).
Livewire is compositional (`step` children); React and Vue are data-driven (`steps`).

components.note: Engine widget on `@zag-js/accordion` (D-030). Children are `accordion-item` / `AccordionItem`, with `items` as the data convenience; React and Vue `Collapse` children become `AccordionItem`.
Engine widget on `@zag-js/collapsible`, rescoped `collapse` (D-030). `variant="read-more"` clamps the text.
Rebuilt on the dialog machine, rescoped `drawer` (D-029). `side` is `end` (the new default) · `start` · `bottom` (the spec's sheet); 2.x `right`, `subtitle` and `actions` are deprecated.
Opens on click as a non-modal dialog, with a CSS-drawn arrow and the author's control as trigger (D-029). 2.x `position` and the `content` slot are deprecated.

components.rename: header → page-header. It is a titled section header, not a site header.
components.note: Ships in all three stacks; `subtitle` becomes `description`.

components.rename: main → app-shell; Sidebar is a part of it.
components.note: Livewire `main` composes sidebar + content + footer. React and Vue only had the sidebar piece, with no page frame. 3.0 ships AppShell in all three stacks with a Menu in its `sidebar` slot (D-031); `main` and `Sidebar` stay as deprecated aliases.
Livewire's version carried a `progress` loading bar and `target`; 3.0 drops them (D-033) and `vertical` becomes `orientation`.

components.consolidation: WidgetGrid and React's StatGroup → Grid, one token-driven primitive in every stack (D-032, D-039). Livewire `widget-grid` is a deprecated alias of `grid`.
components.note: `cols` becomes `columns`; React and Vue's `colsSm` to `colsXl`, `gapX` and `gapY` are dropped for `minItemWidth`.
Token-driven primitive in every stack (D-032); new to Livewire as `stack`. `direction` becomes `orientation`, kept deprecated.
`level` and `size` are separate (D-043); new to React and Vue.

components.consolidation: Livewire `subheading` → Text `size="lead"` (D-043); it was a paragraph, not a heading. `subheading` is a deprecated alias.
components.note: New to React and Vue.
Rows live in a List container (`list` / `List`, D-043), which owns `variant`; new to React and Vue.

components.rename: profile → user-menu. It is an avatar dropdown, not a profile page.
components.consolidation: Resolved as a component that composes DropdownMenu and Avatar (D-044), not a docs recipe. Livewire `profile` is a deprecated alias.
components.note: New to React and Vue.

Livewire had no component: 5 components carried tooltip props and applied raw DaisyUI classes. 3.0 adds Livewire `tooltip` (#59, D-029); the props and `class="tooltip" data-tip` become a wrapping Tooltip.
Dismisses itself (D-034): React and Vue `visible` and `onDismiss` become the built-in dismissal and `open-change`.
One root with `role="status"`, `variant` `spinner` · `dots` (D-034).
`segmented` and `valueText` are new; React `showValue` is dropped (D-034).

components.consolidation: Kept as its own component, not a Progress variant (D-034).
components.note: New to React and Vue.
Built as the D-003 exception (D-037); 2.x `tag`, `prose`, `placeholder` and `showCursor` are removed.
components.launchException: Livewire only. Built on wire:stream; React and Vue would need a different transport.

components.note: New to Livewire as `skeleton`. React `circle` becomes `shape="circle"`.
New to Livewire as `empty-state` (D-036). React and Vue `heading`/`headingAs` become `title`/`headingLevel`.
New to Livewire as `error-state` (D-036). `ErrorDisplay` stays as a deprecated alias in React and Vue.
Initials take a stable color from the name (D-044); groups are `avatar-group` / `AvatarGroup`, new in every stack.
Soft badges get their high-contrast edge from `--apui-border-soft-edge-width` (D-035).
React-only `StatGroup` is dropped and mapped to Grid: a row of stats is a Grid (D-039).

components.consolidation: Kept as its own component built from Stat, with one `stat` object (D-039).
components.note: New to React and Vue.
Server-rendered SVG from shared geometry (D-038); `type` becomes `variant`.

components.structure: Livewire has only the item, composed by hand; React and Vue are data-driven (`items`).
components.note: 3.0 adds a Livewire `timeline` parent and `TimelineItem` in React and Vue; composition is the base (D-040).
Shared diff helpers, no diff library (D-038). `old`/`new` and Vue `before`/`after` become `oldContent`/`newContent`.
Built-in lightbox on the dialog machine (D-041); new to React and Vue.

components.consolidation: Kept as its own component on the carousel widget that Carousel (#65) reuses (D-041).
components.note: New to React and Vue.
Keeps the `WithMediaSync` contract; client logic is `apuiImageLibrary` (D-037).
components.launchException: Livewire only. Tied to Livewire file uploads and the WithMediaSync trait; React and Vue have media-library's MediaModal and MediaGrid.

components.note: One `table` scope; the root is a `div` around the `<table>`, so classes and attributes move off the table element (D-042).
Livewire's is a full Livewire component; event-modal-content is its internal child, not public API.

components.launchException: Livewire only. A theming dev tool rather than a UI component; may move to the docs-site theme builder (#30).

components.note: Not in any wave issue. Add to Utility.
